I saved Ilse's note to the knowledge brain under Quarrendon Freight Lines: 261 seats for the 2026 renewal, with their #north-team message as the source. I also replied in a thread on that message to say it was noted.

A seat count counts as an operational fact here, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed. I didn't do anything else, since Ilse said no action was needed.

The brain can only catch exact duplicates right now, so if a differently worded version of this fact was already saved, it may now be in there twice. I didn't check for one before saving.
